sentences.text:
--- 
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE ANUBHA RAWAT CHOUDHARY ---
05/17.07.2023
1. Learned counsel for the parties are present.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the property involved in the present case was subject-matter of consideration in Title Suit No. 25/1999, which was ultimately decided in favour of the petitioners.

The appeal against the same was also dismissed on 17.06.2009 and execution case was preferred being Execution Case No. 08/2008, in which the order was passed for delivery of possession, but the Superintendent of Police, Garhwa wrote a letter to the Deputy Commissioner, Garhwa that appropriate steps be taken and in the said letter, it has been indicated that five decimals of land out of the property involved in the execution case, falls within the campus of Kandi Police Station.

The learned counsel submits that thereafter, the respondents have been stating that appropriate steps have been taken for acquisition of the same land and the land acquisition proceeding was initiated under the old Act which was numbered as Land Acquisition Case No. 01/2012-13, but ultimately the same has not been taken to a logical end and therefore, the plea of the petitioners is that the land acquisition proceeding has lapsed in terms of Section 11A of the Old Act and corresponding Section 25 of the new Act.
He also submits that no counter-affidavit has been filed by the respondent Nos. 2 and 3.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the respondent-State is directed to seek instructions from the respondent Nos. 2 and 3 and file their affidavit in the present case clarifying the entire position including the position with regard to deposit of the compensation amount in connection with the property involved in the present case.
The respondents shall also bring on record the entire proceedings in connection with L.A. Case No. 01/2012-13.
4. Office is also directed to call for the entire order-sheet of Execution Case No. 08/2008 said to be pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Garhwa.
5. The affidavit of the respondent Nos. 2 and 3 be filed by 21.08.2023.

6. Post this case on 23.08.2023 under appropriate heading.
7.

Since the date has been fixed in the present case awaiting counter-affidavit of the respondent Nos.
2 and 3, I.A. No. 9987/2022 seeking early hearing of the matter is closed.

8. Let this order be communicated to the concerned court through 'e-mail/FAX'.
(Anubha Rawat Choudhary, J.) Mukul Ajay Kumar Singh & Anr vs State Of Jharkhand & Others on 17 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180317777/
